verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a built-in automation scheduler that persists jobs, but nothing shows versioning, reviewing diffs, or rolling back those automations. The "versioned state" phrase on the architecture page is generic and never tied to automations, so it is adjacent at best. Skills being plain SKILL.md files would only allow a user-side git workaround, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
